answer: Clock-skew fingerprint bonds: each identity locks 10 POA, and 6 random validators measure its node's clock drift against a public time beacon every epoch. Identities within 2 ppm of each other share one reward slot. An honest user keeps a full slot for 10 POA, while 1,000 fakes on 20 servers earn only 20 slots yet lock 10,000 POA. Renting 1,000 separate hosts across cloud regions like Oasis, Ivory and Bridge costs about 5,000 USD a month on top of that bond. Anyone can recompute the public drift logs, and a proven cluster loses 50% of its bonds.
